checks: Parent and draft-registration pins match current bytes; all 24 files in the source manifest match their listed hashes.

The D8 reservation contains 256 sorted, unique uint32 seeds; its u32-be vector digest matches. Direct membership check found zero D8 hits in the pinned merged conservative seed history. Parent evidence bounds freshness to accepted-family history, not universal workspace use. D7 and D8 both appear in future-training exclusions; the D5/B/E-opened flag is false.

Cohort arithmetic matches registration and authorization: 2 action repeats by 2 selectors, sampled has 3 controller draws and argmax 1 per repeat; 8 groups and 2,048 games. Limits sum to 23,040,000 native steps and 36,890,624 raw frames, including 13 startup frames per constructed game.

The fixed checkpoint is global update 420, phase update 804, cumulative update 852, pinned by checkpoint bytes and model fingerprint. Inference uses the model only; no optimizer step or checkpoint write occurs, and worker checks weights and checkpoint bytes after every group.

Both action-repeat arms bind the same accepted runtime manifest. Worker verifies loaded module origin, full runtime membership and hashes, MPS availability, float32 model placement, and thread count. The separate 4-condition startup receipt reports passed actual worker/model/native smoke at four 8-frame probes; receipt does not claim full-game timing or D8 outcomes.

Q1 uses the mean of the bottom 192/768 sampled games or 64/256 argmax games. Bootstrap resamples 256 shared seed clusters, keeps all three sampled repetitions per selected seed, and reports the registered 2,000-draw percentile intervals. Primary is sampled_r1 Q1 minus sampled_r4 Q1; success requires observed difference > 0 and registered 95% lower bound > 0. Other contrasts remain descriptive without multiplicity adjustment.

Calibration is explicitly an estimate, not a runtime guarantee: estimated all-capped work 3,804 seconds, 1.5x margin 5,706 seconds, below 7,200-second work cap; absolute resource and wall limits are enforced by worker/supervisor. No extra throughput games were authorized or used.

Registration remains source_review_pending and launch_authority=false. Launcher requires pinned parent acceptances, real empty bytecode cache, clean one-shot outputs, AC power, and parent lease gates before marker use.
limits: Freshness evidence covers only the parent-accepted recorded family and history. It makes no universal workspace nonuse claim and cannot adjudicate unrecorded execution.

Inference is conditional on one frozen checkpoint and fixed controller draw protocol. It does not estimate training-replica variation or authorize training, controller adoption, or checkpoint promotion.
The small runtime smoke is not full-game parity or full-game throughput qualification. Parent actual-runtime, resource, registration, and terminal gates still govern execution and acceptance.
scope: Read-only science, cohort, protocol, registration, and source review. No games, MPS/Torch, outcomes, source edits, SQLite changes, or tests used.
